articles.title: Tarik Skubal agrees to record $450 million, nine-year contract with New York Mets, AP source says
articles.description: Skubal’s agreement includes a full no-trade clause and a $45 million signing bonus that is shielded from the management lockout that threatens the 2027 season, the source said.

articles.title: Tarik Skubal becomes Braves’ NL East rival with Mets
articles.description: Per multiple reports, the Mets signed former Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal to a 9-year, $450 million contract Sunday, adding a new obstacle for the Braves in the NL East.

articles.title: Tarik Skubal moves on from the Dodgers, agrees to record $450-million deal with Mets
articles.description: Free-agent Tarik Skubal plans to sign with the Mets, agreeing to a nine-year, $450-million contract. It is the largest for a pitcher in MLB history.

articles.title: Tigers, former Yankees right-hander Luis Gil agree to one-year deal: Source
articles.description: The Yankees non-tendered the 2024 AL Rookie of the Year on Friday, after a season in which he had a 4.61 ERA in only 27 1/3 innings.

articles.title: Tigers pounce on Yankees castoff Luis Gil, agree to one-year deal: source
articles.description: It didn't take long for Luis Gil to land on his feet.
